description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Search federal space SBIR and STTR R&D contracts and assistance grants ingested from USAspending.gov (NASA, Space Force / SpaceWERX, AFRL, SDA, DARPA, NOAA and NSF): obligated USD amounts, program (SBIR or STTR), phase (Phase I, Phase II, Phase III, Direct to Phase II or Unspecified), topic code, recipient UEI, company attribution and official usaspending.gov award URLs. Filter by company slug, agency, program, phase, search text, date and minimum obligated value.

agency.description: Awarding agency or sub-agency substring, e.g. "NASA", "Space Force", "DARPA", "NOAA", "NSF".

limit.description: How many SBIR/STTR awards to return (1 to 25).

min_amount_usd.description: Minimum obligated amount in US dollars.

offset.description: Awards to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

phase.description: SBIR/STTR phase strictly as stated in the official award record.

program.description: Federal innovation program: SBIR or STTR.

query.description: Search words in recipient name, topic code, award PIID or award description.

since.description: Awards with action date on or after this UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: research_sbir_awards
title: Federal space SBIR/STTR awards
